results.detail: Only configured actual target registered; no invented position.
Actual AMR initial coordinates received from configuration.
Actual source is configuration-based; assigned destination shown in selected AMR window.
Visible destination dialog rejects non-finite input and applies valid actual mission coordinates without moving AMR.
GUI MOVE published; actual BUSY seen; publication is not reported as completed.
STOP actually stopped movement; original MOVE failed, STOP has independent SUCCESS.
Position stays stopped while Heartbeat and Telemetry continue.
Manual restart creates new request ID and uses stopped current position as source.
Closing separate window does not stop actual AMR movement.
Reopened window remains bound to actual target.
Actual arrival, matching final ACK and same-basis remaining distance zero confirmed.
Alarm test fixture traversed real MQTT into active GUI alarm; not Simulator fault-scenario implementation.
Actual session-history filter applied.
History reset changes filter/selection only, preserving actual records.
Duplicate final ACK does not repeat business/history transition.
Conflicting ACK flagged while original SUCCESS preserved.
Disconnected real AMR remains registered with last position; current state is unknown.
Reconnect alone does not mark old coordinates fresh.
No automatic command replay after reconnect; old completion is not current arrival at restarted coordinates.
After GUI closes and its communication owner stops, independent AMR completes MOVE and sends final ACK to separate observer.
